name: Dcipher Analytics
description:
Dcipher is a research and analytics platform that collects large volumes of external content - web, news, social media, your own files - and turns it into structured, analyzable data. This connector gives Claude access to your Dcipher workspace, so you can work through the whole platform in conversation.

Claude can run research agents, build and manage knowledge bases, search them and answer questions with references back to source documents, and set up Insight Boosters, Dcipher's insight and foresight analytics engine. It can produce content landscapes, trend radar charts, comparison matrices, scenario analysis views and write reports from your sources, and schedule workflows so everything stays current.

You describe what you want to know. Claude figures out which parts of Dcipher get you there - whether that means collecting new material, querying what you already have, or building a dashboard on top of it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dcipher Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dcipher Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dcipheranalytics.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dcipher Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dcipher Analytics lists 72 MCP tools, including apply_project_filter, archive_insight_booster, ask_research_chatbot, attach_knowledge_base_to_insight_booster, check_kb_has_timestamp, clone_insight_booster, create_file_kb, create_insight_booster, create_insight_booster_report_template, create_insight_booster_view, create_insight_booster_workbench, and create_news_kb.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dcipher Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dcipher Analytics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Dcipher Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dcipher Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dcipher Analytics is developed by Dcipher Analytics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
